name: DigiBi — Web Lead Intake
description: Website lead intake: files the lead in HubSpot, classifies intent with Gemini, and dispatches the sales or FAQ Retell agent when a phone number is present.

nodes.name: Website Lead Webhook
nodes.notes: Point the site N8N_LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL (api/lead.js, api/contact.js) at this node PRODUCTION url.

nodes.name: Normalize Web Lead
nodes.notes: Handles contact-form and lead-magnet payloads. Skips anything without an email. Marks every web lead lead_status=lead — NOT auto-dialled.

nodes.name: Upsert Web Lead Contact
nodes.notes: Same upsert + digibi_* schema as the Inbound Router.

nodes.name: Notify New Web Lead (optional)
nodes.notes: OPTIONAL, disabled by default. Site already emails a notification; enable only for a Slack ping. Set REPLACE_ME_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.

options.systemMessage:
You classify a website contact-form submission for DigiBi (digi-bi.com), which sells AI voice receptionists / AI phone & chat agents to trades and service businesses. Decide the person's intent and output exactly one category:
- "lead": a prospective customer. This is the DEFAULT.
- "faq": ONLY a general informational or support question with no buying intent.
When unsure, choose "lead". Respond with ONLY a valid JSON object like {"category":"lead"}, no markdown fences.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ from_number: 'REPLACE_ME_FAQ_ASSISTANT_FROM_NUMBER', to_number: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.phone, override_agent_id: 'REPLACE_ME_FAQ_ASSISTANT_AGENT_ID', retell_llm_dynamic_variables: { first_name: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.first_name, last_name: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.last_name, email: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.email, company: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.industry, country: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.country, how_heard: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.how_heard, enquiry_context: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.notes }, metadata: { call_type: 'faq', hubspot_email: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.email, first_name: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.first_name, last_name: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.last_name, phone: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.phone, country: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.country } }) }}

nodes.name: Dispatch FAQ Retell Agent
nodes.notes: FAQ Retell agent for general questions with a phone. Uses the Retell API credential. Set the REPLACE_ME FAQ agent id + from-number in the body.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ from_number: 'REPLACE_ME_OUTBOUND_FOLLOWUP_FROM_NUMBER', to_number: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.phone, override_agent_id: 'REPLACE_ME_OUTBOUND_FOLLOWUP_AGENT_ID', retell_llm_dynamic_variables: { first_name: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.first_name, last_name: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.last_name, email: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.email, company: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.industry, country: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.country, how_heard: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.how_heard, enquiry_context: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.notes }, metadata: { call_type: 'lead', hubspot_email: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.email, first_name: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.first_name, last_name: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.last_name, phone: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.phone, country: $('Normalize Web Lead').item.json.country } }) }}

nodes.name: Dispatch Sales Retell Agent
nodes.notes: Outbound follow-up Retell agent for brand-new web leads (isNew) with a phone. Uses the Retell API credential. Set the REPLACE_ME agent id + from-number in the body.
